correction.statement: Kyverno 1.13.0 adds an optional spec.apiCall.retryLimit field (default 3, minimum 1) to GlobalContextEntry. Entries that use apiCall without setting retryLimit now retry failed API calls 3 times by default. Entries that set retryLimit explicitly are shielded.
